ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity (white) contiguous regions located on the lateral lobes. Left lobe features a large triangular white patch with internal dark speckling. Right lobe contains an irregular white patch with significant interior dark mottling and a fragmented upper border near the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 55 degrees and significant vertical penetration into the fluke center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary shows moderate frequency, low-amplitude serrations, particularly localized on the medial half of the right lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve terminating in tapered, slightly upturned and caudally-oriented tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered small-scale white pixel clusters visible at the inferior margin of the peduncle attachment and within the dark central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, thin linear pixel disruptions oriented diagonally across the high-intensity patch of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor irregular edge loss/indentation on the distal end of the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct 'winged' white pigmentation pattern characterized by heavy internal dark mottling on both lobes.
